7698.title: Local Git events redundantly resolve default-branch refs
7698.rootCauseOneLine: Local-only watcher batches have no shared-ref snapshot, so reportCurrentBranch rereads an already-known default branch and spawns redundant Git processes.

prReviews.verdict: Targets root cause — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Separate resolved-default state avoids repeated ref lookups; linked PR code was not executed.

7698.proposedFix: Cache the resolved default branch in existing watch state, refresh on shared-ref changes, and distinguish resolved null from not-yet-resolved undefined.
7698.caveats: Same-agent second clean run; real Git with an injected watcher callback. Three redundant subprocesses measured; no platform timing benchmark. Full regression source and actual output are inline in the report. No duplicate PR because #7705 already closes this issue.
